description: Multi-DEX Perpetual Futures CLI - Pacifica, Hyperliquid, Lighter, Aster, Lighter RH, Ondo Perps, Arcus, QFEX, RISEx (read-only), TxFlow (market data, unofficial API)

tool_signatures.name: --levels
tool_signatures.description: Executes a large order in small slices over a time period (Time-Weighted Average Price) to minimize market impact

tool_signatures.name: arb-aggressive
tool_signatures.description: Low spread (10%), $100/leg, 5 positions — captures smaller opportunities

tool_signatures.name: arb-conservative
tool_signatures.description: High spread threshold (30%), small size ($30/leg), 2 max positions

tool_signatures.name: arb_scan
tool_signatures.description: Scan for funding rate arbitrage opportunities across exchanges. Finds symbols with the largest funding rate spreads

symbols.description: Filter to specific symbols. Omit for all

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Filter to specific symbols. Omit for all

tool_signatures.name: cascadeOiDropPct
tool_signatures.description: OI drop % to trigger cascade mode

tool_signatures.name: cascadeSpread
tool_signatures.description: Cascade mode spread in basis points

tool_signatures.name: close_rate
tool_signatures.description: Close if avg rate falls below this %

tool_signatures.name: dca-daily
tool_signatures.description: Buy once per day, 30 orders — steady accumulation over 1 month

tool_signatures.name: dca-dip-buyer
tool_signatures.description: Buy only when volatility is high — accumulate during dips

tool_signatures.name: dca-hourly
tool_signatures.description: Buy every hour, 24 orders — short-term aggressive accumulation

tool_signatures.name: dca-seller
tool_signatures.description: Sell (short) periodically — dollar-cost average out of a position

tool_signatures.name: entryThreshold
tool_signatures.description: Extra threshold beyond band (0 = band touch)

tool_signatures.name: explain_command
tool_signatures.description: Explain what a perp CLI command does, its parameters, and any risks. Helps the user understand a command before running it

tool_signatures.name: gamma
tool_signatures.description: Risk aversion γ, per price unit (1/$)

tool_signatures.name: get_arb_compare
tool_signatures.description: Compare active arbitrage positions side by side — ROI, funding income, price PnL, and annualized returns for each position

tool_signatures.name: get_balance
tool_signatures.description: Get account balance (equity, available margin, margin used, unrealized PnL) on an exchange. ${HL_SCOPE_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: get_funding_analysis
tool_signatures.description: Analyze funding income across exchanges — cumulative totals, annualized rates, and per-arb-position breakdown. Great for tracking funding arb profitability.

tool_signatures.name: get_funding_rates
tool_signatures.description: Compare funding rates across every market-data venue. Returns rates per symbol with spread analysis

tool_signatures.name: get_markets
tool_signatures.description: Get all available perpetual futures markets on an exchange, including price, funding rate, volume, and max leverage. Works without API keys (public market data). ${HL_SCOPE_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: get_open_orders
tool_signatures.description: Get all open/pending orders on an exchange. ${HL_SCOPE_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: get_orderbook
tool_signatures.description: Get the order book (bids and asks) for a symbol on an exchange. Works without API keys on every venue with an account API (configured credentials → the account adapter; none → the public endpoint / read-only adapter); market-data-only venues have no orderbook path. ${HL_SCOPE_NOTE}

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Trading pair symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

tool_signatures.name: get_outcome_book
tool_signatures.description: Get the orderbook for one outcome side. Public read — no API key needed.

outcome.description: Outcome id from outcomeMeta (e.g., 1 for the BTC binary daily)

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Outcome id from outcomeMeta (e.g., 1 for the BTC binary daily)

tool_signatures.name: get_outcome_markets
tool_signatures.description: List active Hyperliquid Outcome markets (HIP-4). Each market has parsed metadata (underlying asset, target price, expiry, period) and per-side info (Yes/No name, encoding, asset id, current mid). Public read — no API key needed.

tool_signatures.name: get_pnl_analysis
tool_signatures.description: P&L analysis combining trading fees and funding income — shows net profit/loss by exchange with daily breakdown

tool_signatures.name: get_positions
tool_signatures.description: Get all open positions on an exchange, including size, entry price, PnL, leverage. ${HL_SCOPE_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: get_prices
tool_signatures.description: Get cross-exchange prices for symbols. Fetches mark prices from every market-data venue for comparison

tool_signatures.name: grid-aggressive
tool_signatures.description: Tight range (±1.5%), 20 grids, 5x leverage — high frequency, high risk

tool_signatures.name: grid-conservative
tool_signatures.description: Wide range (±5%), 8 grids, small size, no leverage — low risk sideways strategy

tool_signatures.name: grid-long-bias
tool_signatures.description: Long-biased grid (±3%), 10 grids — profit from uptrend + range trading

tool_signatures.name: grid-standard
tool_signatures.description: Medium range (±3%), 12 grids, moderate size — balanced grid trading

tool_signatures.name: gridSpacing
tool_signatures.description: Spacing between levels in basis points

tool_signatures.name: guardPreset
tool_signatures.description: Guard stop preset: conservative, moderate, aggressive

tool_signatures.name: hedgeRatio
tool_signatures.description: Fraction of excess exposure to hedge (0–1)

tool_signatures.name: kappa
tool_signatures.description: Order-book liquidity κ, per price unit (1/$)

tool_signatures.name: maxCapitalPct
tool_signatures.description: Max % of total capital per position (e.g., 20 = 20%)

tool_signatures.name: maxNotionalUsd
tool_signatures.description: Max net notional USD before hedging

tool_signatures.name: maxPositionSize
tool_signatures.description: Maximum order size per LLM decision

tool_signatures.name: minSignalStrength
tool_signatures.description: Min EMA divergence ratio to act

tool_signatures.name: normalSpread
tool_signatures.description: Normal mode spread in basis points

tool_signatures.name: perp
tool_signatures.description: Multi-DEX Perpetual Futures CLI (Pacifica, Hyperliquid, Lighter)

tool_signatures.name: perpPerpCloseSpread
tool_signatures.description: Close perp-perp when spread reverses below this % (0 = only on reversal)

tool_signatures.name: perpPerpMinSpread
tool_signatures.description: Min annualized spread % for perp-perp entry

tool_signatures.name: portfolio
tool_signatures.description: Cross-exchange portfolio summary: balances, positions, and risk metrics across all exchanges with configured credentials

tool_signatures.name: sigma
tool_signatures.description: Volatility in $ per √second (0 = estimate from the candles

tool_signatures.name: sizeUsd
tool_signatures.description: Position size in USD per leg

tool_signatures.name: spotPerpRatio
tool_signatures.description: Spot-perp mode is NOT supported here (a value > 0 fails with CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED) — use spot-perp-arb

tool_signatures.name: spreadBps
tool_signatures.description: Spread offset per slice in basis points

tool_signatures.name: suggest_command
tool_signatures.description: Given a natural language trading goal, suggest the exact perp CLI commands to run. Does NOT execute anything — only returns commands for the user to review and run manually
